title: Independent ideas. Extraordinary finds.
intro: A daily selection of independent games and useful Android apps, with original F7 insights and links to their creators.

entries.name: BlockDrop
entries.summary: BlockDrop is a cross-platform falling-block puzzle game built with Flutter. The game offers classic block-stacking mechanics with modern visuals and smooth animations. Players can compete for high scores across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, desktop, and web browsers. The project is open source under the MIT license.
features: Classic falling-block puzzle gameplay with modern Flutter rendering.
Cross-platform support: Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web.
High score tracking and competitive gameplay.
Open source under MIT license with active development.
entries.insight: BlockDrop takes the familiar tetromino formula and rebuilds it in Flutter, which means one codebase runs everywhere from phones to browsers. The MIT license and active maintenance make it a rare example of a polished cross-platform puzzle game that stays free and open.

entries.name: 15 Puzzle
entries.summary: 15 Puzzle is a simple Android sliding puzzle game with a clean interface. Players rearrange numbered tiles in a 4x4 grid to restore the correct order. The game is open source under the MIT license and available on Google Play and F-Droid. It offers a minimalist design focused on the classic puzzle mechanics.
features: Available on Google Play and F-Droid.
entries.insight: The 15 puzzle is one of those simple ideas that has survived for over a century. This Android version keeps it honest: no ads, no complications, just the tiles and the MIT license. It is a good example of a classic game done right on mobile.

entries.name: Fossify Launcher
entries.summary: Fossify Launcher is an Android home screen replacement that lets you customize your layout, app drawer, widgets, and search without a content feed. The app works offline and does not request Internet permission. It is part of the Fossify suite of privacy-focused Android apps and is available on Google Play and F-Droid.
features: Customize home screen layout, app drawer, and widgets.
Search apps and content directly from the home screen.
Works offline without requesting Internet permission.
Part of the Fossify privacy-focused app suite.
Available on Google Play and F-Droid.
entries.insight: A launcher is the first thing you see on your phone, and Fossify Launcher makes that first impression count without tracking you. No content feed, no Internet permission, just your apps arranged the way you want them. It is what a launcher should be when the goal is usefulness rather than engagement metrics.
